stem: A gardener uses 200 meters of fencing to enclose a rectangular plot along a straight wall. No fencing is needed along the wall. If each of the two sides perpendicular to the wall is \(x\) meters long, the area of the plot, in square meters, is \(A(x) = x(200 - 2x)\). What is the greatest possible area, in square meters, of the plot?
solution: \(A(x) = -2x^{2} + 200x\) is a parabola that opens downward; its zeros are \(x = 0\) and \(x = 100\).
The vertex is halfway between the zeros, at \(x = 50\).
verify:
x = symbols('x')
A = x*(200 - 2*x)
crit = solve(diff(A, x), x)
assert crit == [50] and diff(A, x, 2) < 0
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == [A.subs(x, 50)] == [5000]
